description: ONS publishes daily observed rainfall for 2020 and 2021 from meteorological stations and rain gauges. Its documentation describes station location, observation date and precipitation in millimetres, totalled at 12 TMG. The operator used these observations for inflow forecasting and subsequently switched to a combined station-and-satellite precipitation product. The historical station files are no longer updated. Some JSON-dictionary field codes contain misplaced descriptive text, so column names must be checked against the published file before use. Coverage is meteorological and rain-gauge stations in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
